message.content:
C♯ major has **seven sharps** in its key signature:

| Sharp | Note |
|-------|------|
| F♯    | 1st |
| C♯    | 2nd |
| G♯    | 3rd |
| D♯    | 4th |
| A♯    | 5th |
| E♯    | 6th |
| B♯    | 7th |

So the key signature for C♯ major is the same as that of the key with all seven sharps.
